effect_unit_note: Five published site-specific r_p estimates are the independent units: fragmented Mesa/Nacastillo/Ranchitos versus continuous Careyes/Chamela. Higher r_p means fewer effective sires/lower mating support, so orientation=-1. Sampling variance uses locked metafor SMD vtype=LS.

Table 2 supplies one adult Sp estimate per same study site. Sp measures strength of adult spatial genetic structure; higher fragmentation-induced structure is deterioration, so orientation=-1. The site-specific b_log slopes were reported nonsignificant; this row estimates the between-habitat contrast in the published site-level Sp values and does not reinterpret individual-site nonsignificance as equivalence. Sampling variance uses locked metafor SMD vtype=LS.
